metadata.description: Faction-vs-faction conflict outcome line sets for staged escalation.

aggressor: UFP contact on scope. Ufp traffic, maintain vector and identify.
UFP acknowledges ufp transponder. Continue clean and predictable burns.
response: Ufp acknowledges ufp watch.
Ufp confirms lane intent and traffic compliance.

aggressor: Ufp vessel, your profile raises concern. Clarify cargo and destination.
UFP requests immediate route declaration from ufp traffic.
response: Ufp provides declared route and cargo class.
Ufp disputes the concern but remains on channel.

aggressor: Intercept posture initiated by UFP. Reduce burn and submit to hold.
UFP orders ufp contact to inspection vector.
response: Ufp acknowledges hold under protest.
Ufp attempts to negotiate delay before inspection.

aggressor: UFP warning fire pattern active. Comply now.
UFP weapons release authorized on propulsion only.
response: Ufp reports incoming fire and evasive maneuvering.
Ufp declares emergency traffic incident.

aggressor: UFP disengages and logs incident for review.
UFP clears lane after contact resolution.
response: Ufp breaks contact and resumes safer routing.
Ufp confirms separation and files incident claim.
